items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: I've done recordings with Josh White and a lot of artists there.

ctx.x: Yes, they did, they got out quite a bit. He did business with somebody else. I forget the name of that company. He did all kinds of things trying to get the artists heard. That was his main thing. I've done recordings with Josh White and a lot of artists there. I'd get a lot of recording artists for him and then he allowed me to go to Pittsburgh to record some musicians. I went there.
After you finished in Cafe Society, where did you go then?
